rules: The National Polygon Service contains three licensed, chargeable datasets.
The three datasets are available as part of the National Polygon Service and require agreement to a licence.
The National Polygon dataset describes more than 25 million titles.
The National Polygon dataset describes 28 million polygons.
HM Land Registry index polygons are mapped against Ordnance Survey MasterMap large-scale mapping.
The Title Descriptor dataset describes legal interests recorded against freehold and leasehold estates in England and Wales.
A registered estate receives a unique title number, enabling data retrieval from individual records.
UPRNs are unique 12-digit numbers created by local authorities and Ordnance Survey.
An addressable UK location keeps its UPRN for the lifetime of the property.
Ordnance Survey uses AddressBase to link property information to mapping where possible.
A title number and UPRN can only be linked when a relationship exists between the AddressBase address and title number.
Using UPRNs and title numbers together supports matching and merging datasets from different sources.
The free National Polygon Service sample is a five-square-kilometre Bristol extract dated 5 February 2016.
The sample contains National Polygon, Title Descriptor and Title Number/UPRN Look Up data.
